cast_dialogue.linea: The particle 'down' brings things to the ground, heroes: failures, calm, reductions... but from the ground we rise stronger.
My laptop broke down while I was editing, and my car broke down on the motorway. What a week!
Calm down, Ben. Sit down, write down the problems, and narrow them down to the important ones.
I turned down an expensive repair and decided to cut down on coffee to save money.
When it pours down, I lie down and listen to the rain. Nothing weighs me down, mis héroes.

banco_oraciones.oracion: She wrote down all the problems.
They narrowed the choices down to two.
The internet didn't go down this time.
Can you turn down the music?
Why did they close down the factory?
Did she calm down? Yes, she did.
Did he turn down the job? No, he didn't.
Did the prices go down? No, they didn't.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Phrasal verbs with 'down' express failure (break down, go down), reduction (cut down on, narrow down, slow down), rejection (turn down, let down) or relaxation (calm down, lie down). Many are separable: 'turn the music down' / 'turn it down'.

cut down on, narrow down, slow down
calm down, lie down, sit down

ejercicios.pregunta: Describe a bad day using three phrasal verbs with 'down'.
ejercicios.respuesta: My car broke down, my internet went down, and I had to calm down and write down my problems.

guion: Kenji: You look stressed, Ben. Sit down and tell me.
Ben: Everything went wrong. My laptop broke down while I was editing.
Ben: Yes — my car broke down on the motorway, and then my internet went down!
Kenji: Wow. Calm down. Write down the problems and narrow them down.
Ben: I did. The repair costs a fortune, but I turned it down.
Kenji: Good decision. Slow down, have some tea, and we'll fix it together.

reading.texto: Last week everything went wrong for Ben. His laptop broke down while he was editing photos, his car broke down on the motorway, and his internet went down during a video call. He tried to calm down, sat down, and wrote down all the problems. Then he narrowed the choices down to two: fix the laptop or buy a new one. In the end, he turned down an expensive repair and slowed down to think.

preguntas.afirmacion: Ben's car broke down on the motorway.
Ben narrowed the choices down to three.
